After the first session of the Human Retina Cell Atlas and RGC hackaton, there are some edits to implement into CL.

- [x] #3176
- [ ] #3177
    There are many cases with details of synaptic IO and morphology (mono vs bis-stratified) that are not reflected in formal axioms.  A more complete representation might help with reconciliation.
- [ ] #3179
Main focus = mouse where we have two nomenclatures + more in the literature.
- [x] #3178
  starting with the classes that are populated (midget ON & OFF and parasol ON & OFF)


See General discussion document here https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WVy8AiGKmOeUoz10Sr1uXtkbHCSNuze0WFZtbQrcmYY/edit?tab=t.0. - also this comment: https://github.com/obophenotype/cell-ontology/issues/2217#issuecomment-2640028545
